item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 20 October 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 20 October 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) 🚩 The Vostok Group's units continued to advance into the depth of the enemy's defence and liberated the village of Timoshevka in Zaporozhye region. 💥 Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a marine brigade close to Kolomiytsy, Podgavrilovka, Dibrova (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novorozovka, Volnyanka, and Barvinovka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ More than 170 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, and two motor vehicles have been neutralised. ↗️ The Dnepr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. Russian elements hit formations of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and a marine brigade near Kirovo, Orekhov, and Preobrazhenka in Zaporozhye region. ▪️ Up to 30 troops, 16 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations of the enemy were neutralised. ✈️ Operational-tactical aviation, unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on launch sites of long-range unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 146 areas. ▫️ Air defence systems shot down 383 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. 📊 In total , since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost : ▫️ 674 aircraft, ▫️ 284 helicopters, ▫️ 265,933 unmanned aerial vehicles, ▫

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 Units of the Sever Group of Forces took advantageous lines and positions . Russian troops inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade and a motorised infantry brigade of the AFU near Izbitskoye, Berezhnoye, Velikiy Burluk, and Tomakhovka in Kharkov region. 🔥 In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at formations of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade close to Khoten, Nikolskoye, and Velikaya Rybitsa (Sumy region). ▪️ The enemy lost more than 235 troops, 13 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations. ↗️ The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade close to Pleskachovka, Blagodatovka, Tamarganovka (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 22 motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations. 📍 Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. Russian units inflicted losses on formations of two mechanised brigades, an air assault brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Kondratovka, and Semenovka in the Donetsk People's Republic. ▪️ The enemy lost
item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took advantageous lines and positions
. Russian troops inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade and a motorised infantry brigade of the AFU near Izbitskoye, Berezhnoye, Velikiy Burluk, and Tomakhovka in Kharkov region.
🔥
In Sumy region,
strikes were delivered at formations of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade close to Khoten, Nikolskoye, and Velikaya Rybitsa (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 235 troops, 13 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade close to Pleskachovka, Blagodatovka, Tamarganovka (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 22 motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Russian units inflicted losses on formations of two mechanised brigades, an air assault brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Kondratovka, and Semenovka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 215 troops, one tank and two armoured fighting vehicles, 44 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
💥
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units engaged manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, a jaeger brigade, an airborne brigade of the AFU, and two national guard brigades near Zavidovo-Kudashevo, Krivorozhye, Starorayskoye, Starovarvarovka, Shilovka, Malotaranovka, Verovka, Belozerskoye (Donetsk People's Republic), and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
Up to 340 troops, six armoured fighting vehicles, five motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and two electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
👉
See
Part 2

item.title: 🤝 'The military signalmen always come to the rescue' Military signalmen of the 20th Combined Arms Army (Zapad Group of Forces) shoulder to shoulder with local specialists are repai
item.description: 🤝 'The military signalmen always come to the rescue' Military signalmen of the 20th Combined Arms Army (Zapad Group of Forces) shoulder to shoulder with local specialists are repairing what the enemy has destroyed. Maintenance of high towers, repair of fibre-optic lines after shelling takes enormous efforts and time. 💬 Andrei, the chief engineer of a telecommunication company, does not hide emotions, telling about such interaction: 'Military signalmen always come to the rescue if there is some sort of emergency situation in which it requires to restore lines or communication equipment. Though their work is mostly behind the scenes, it’s what keeps us feeling safe and connected to the rest of the world'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against the facilities of Ukraine's port infrastructure, as well a
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against the facilities of Ukraine's port infrastructure, as well as ships operating in the interests of the AFU. As a result of the strikes, the following targets were hit: 📍 in Khmelnitsky region: 💥 The Grand Import logistics centre in the city of Khmelnitsky, which is used to store military and dual-use cargo of the Armed Forces of Ukraine; 📍 in Volyn region: 💥 the Vendor Trans Service LLC transport and logistics centre in Kovel, used for storage and distribution of AFU cargo and materiel; 📍 in Odessa region: 💥 three dry cargo vessels unloading military and dual-use cargo used by the AFU, as well as port infrastructure facilities that support the operation of cargo terminals in the port of Reni. 💥 In addition, one dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Ukraine was hit on its way to the port of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 East is a delicate matter. That is why we train together. Russian personnel have arrived in the Republic of Uzbekistan to take part in the Hamkorlik 2026 joint exercise.
item.description: 🤝 East is a delicate matter. That is why we train together. 📍 Russian personnel have arrived in the Republic of Uzbekistan to take part in the Hamkorlik 2026 joint exercise. ➡️ The units marched more than 300 kilometres through the mountainous terrain of Tajikistan and Uzbekistan before arriving at the Termez training ground in the Republic of Uzbekistan. 👉 There, Russian units began maintaining and preparing their equipment for the active phase of the exercise, which will take place from 20 to 27 October. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
